breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions (Dirichlet on the entire boundary and also periodic). The ground truth resolved this by removing the periodic condition. The generated specification correctly identified the conflict and explicitly stated to 'Enforce Dirichlet boundary conditions only' and to 'Ignore the periodic boundary condition line entirely', which perfectly aligns with the correction in the ground truth.
